Validated sync-server disconnect/blocklist behavior and the new teardown coverage.
Verified the backend crate still builds.

diffSummary: The sidecar now has a real pairing-code join path that restarts sync with the current runtime config and supplied iroh ticket, accepts both pairing_code/code payloads, and explicitly disconnects both inbound sessions and matching outbound clients before emitting peer lifecycle events. Added tests cover the new restart-param rewrite, alias handling, and peer teardown paths in main.rs and sync_server.rs.
